one_liner: Grain (grain.com) meeting recorder with a documented REST public API, PAT and OAuth2 auth, free-plan PAT access, and an official remote MCP server.
auth_notes: Bearer token in Authorization header. PAT (personal) and WAT (workspace, admin only, Business/Enterprise) are static non-expiring tokens; OAuth2 authorization code with PKCE for distributed integrations. Requests also need a Public-Api-Version header.
access_notes: Personal API access (PAT) is available on every plan including Free. Workspace tokens need Business/Enterprise. OAuth app registration process is not fully clear; a Nango note says developer access is limited to select partners (possibly outdated), and a third-party page claims Business plan is required (contradicted by Grain's own support article).
blocker_notes: Minor uncertainty over OAuth client registration (redirect URI registration step) and workspace-scope plan gating; PAT works on Free.

evidence.quote: The API supports a standard OAuth2 Authorization Code flow, including the PKCE extension for client-side only authentication.
